raw_snippet: Verisk’s ISO Core Lines and Emerging Issues teams developed new general liability endorsements that allow carriers to exclude generative AI exposures.
value_text: ISO's generative-AI exclusion endorsements for general liability take effect (January 2026)
note: Verisk's ISO forms CG 40 47, CG 40 48 and CG 35 08, edition date January 2026; optional, so each insurer chooses whether to attach them.

raw_snippet: She has seen carriers increasingly submit filings with state insurance regulators to be able to use three ISO endorsements.
value_text: An insurance lawyer reports carriers increasingly filing to use ISO's generative-AI exclusions (Jul 2026)
note: Claims Journal, 20 Jul 2026, quoting an attorney who practises in the cyber space.
